entries.text: Every cell now links to an official source. Newly documented: Germany's portal terms (max 60 searches or retrievals per hour; no systematic retrieval), KVK Open Dataset licence (CC BY 4.0) and limits (1 query/min per IP, 200 per 5 min for all users), CVR on Datafordeler (CC BY 4.0), BRIS terms. Where the source is silent, the cell now reads 'Not documented'.

v1 of the directory: 12 national registers, the EU VAT check (VIES), the EU-wide register search (BRIS) and Switzerland's Zefix. Every fact links to the official page it came from; anything we couldn't confirm is marked unverified.
Poland's KRS open API and its documentation page showed a 'Przerwa techniczna' (technical maintenance) notice instead of data.
KVK Open Dataset API enforces 1 query per minute; a second call within a minute returned HTTP 429.
Brønnøysund added /api/konsernstruktur/{orgnr} (corporate group structure, JSON and CSV). Source: the API's own changelog.
